audit_scope: Read-only static audit; no training, model promotion, data download, or artifact deserialization.

production_artifact.calibration: Calibrated model; metadata type and training reports identify probability calibration. Serialized object was not deserialized during audit.
production_artifact.hash_check: The local model, feature-list, and feature-extractor hashes match values recorded in model_metadata.json.
production_artifact.integrity_limit: service.py checks model/feature hashes only when nonempty expected hash values exist. model_metadata.json is not signed, so this is not an authenticity chain.
production_artifact.serialized_artifact_loading: Not performed; Python pickle/joblib artifacts can execute code during deserialization.

feature_schema.ordering_evidence: The ordered feature list in metadata matches the production feature-list artifact SHA-256; pickle was not loaded.

excluded_features.IsHTTPS: Retained by feature extraction/evidence but excluded from model after protocol counterfactuals indicated a spurious shift.

classification.risk_score: Rounded, clamped 0-100 interpolation between the SAFE and PHISHING thresholds.

config_fallbacks.note: config.py defaults differ from active metadata and are used only if metadata threshold values are absent/invalid.

training_data.provenance: Metadata says the input file has no upstream source, license, or collection-date fields.
training_data.current_preparation_status: Root dataset_summary.json states BLOCKED_NO_REAL_LEGITIMATE_ROWS_FOR_REQUIRED_COHORTS; no replacement clean dataset or domain-disjoint split was generated.

threshold_selection.method: Maximize SAFE coverage with <=2% false-safe rate and PHISHING recall with <=1% benign phishing rate.

external_validation.reason: No compatible external source with verified reuse licensing was integrated.

historical_report.interpretation: Can describe misses within that positive-only feed only; FPR and overall population performance are not measurable.

experimental_candidates.role: Experimental candidate, not referenced by service.py.

failed_gates: Phishing on a fixed legitimate baseline
Recall materially below strongest validated reference

experimental_candidates.candidate: Domain-only hostname character TF-IDF plus Logistic Regression, n-grams 2-6
known_gate_gaps: Candidate fast.com SAFE regression results not persisted
Candidate size approximately 8.8x current model; acceptance not established

known_bias_and_failure_modes: Production training provenance and dates are unavailable; temporal/generalization drift cannot be measured.
Random split leaks registered domains across train/test (3,272 overlaps); domain-aware split has zero overlap but remains dataset-specific.
The data is artificially class-balanced and does not represent real deployment prevalence.
URL-only lexical features cannot inspect page content, redirects, DNS, or live reputation.
PathLength has importance 0.2483 and dominates the saved feature-importance table; lexical shortcuts are a bias concern.
Saved model metadata records domain-holdout recall 0.7218 and FNR 0.2782 at threshold 0.5.
The `fast.com` false-positive history is a known regression case; production report says current canonical variants are SAFE at probability 0.060029.
Phishing-only external reports cannot measure false positives; report metrics cannot be interpreted as balanced external accuracy.
The dynamic candidate's saved evaluation fails promotion gates, including a false-phishing event on the fixed benign baseline and low-recall hard cohorts.

dataset_and_report_conflicts.conflict: Active metadata claims a 234,432-row final_dataset_v2.csv source; root summary states replacement preparation is blocked and only 95 real benign rows are retained; processed summary describes an earlier 854,870-row PhiUSIIL plus phishing-feed pipeline.
Metadata contains saved random/domain metrics, but latest metrics.json is blocked because the available candidate dataset hash differs from the production metadata hash.
Active model metadata says external validation was not run; an older report contains positive-only phishing-feed measurements.
Fallback defaults are 0.45/0.85, active serving metadata uses 0.1314095638/0.6961575221, and historical model documentation cites yet another superseded threshold pair.

preexisting_json_syntax_issues.issue: Contains a bare NaN value for roc_auc; rejected by strict JSON parsers.
Contains a bare NaN value for roc_auc; rejected by strict JSON parsers.

missing_information: The original final_dataset_v2.csv and generated clean_dataset.csv are absent; exact row-level training examples cannot be reconstructed.
No upstream dataset license, provenance, or collection dates are attached to the production training source.
Only 95 row-level real benign dynamic URLs remain; missing required URL structures cannot be recovered from aggregate category counts.
No temporal validation or independent balanced validation is available.
Current Python model-load compatibility was not tested; local venv, training metadata, and CI target different Python versions.
Candidate artifacts were not deserialized; only their paths/sizes and saved metadata/reports were inspected.
